key_idea: Pad to 2M items with zeros, sort, and pair the i-th smallest with the i-th largest; the answer is the largest pair sum.
sketch: With at most two items per scout and N<=2M, add zero-size dummy items until there are exactly 2M, sort, and pair a[i] with a[2M-1-i]. The classic exchange argument shows this minimises the maximum pair sum. O(N log N). Sums reach 2e7 so int suffices.
